column1: A photoreceptor molecule in plant cells has been found to have a second job as a thermometer after dark – allowing plants to read seasonal temperature changes.
column2: 研究发现，植物细胞里的一种光受体分子在天黑后还兼作温度计，让植物能够感知季节性气温变化。
column9: seasonal temperature changes|季节性气温变化

column1: Scientists say the discovery could help breed crops that are more resilient to the temperatures expected to result from climate change
column2: 科学家说，这一发现可能有助于培育作物，使它们能更好地适应气候变化预计会带来的温度条件。

column1: An international team of scientists led by the University of Cambridge has discovered that the ‘thermometer’ molecule in plants enables them to develop according to seasonal temperature changes.
column2: 一个由剑桥大学牵头的国际科研团队发现，植物体内的“温度计”分子使植物能随季节性气温变化调节自身发育。

column1: Researchers have revealed that molecules called phytochromes – used by plants to detect light during the day – actually change their function in darkness to become cellular temperature gauges that measure the heat of the night.
column2: 研究人员发现，一类名叫光敏色素的分子，白天为植物探测光线；到了黑暗中，其功能会改变，成为细胞内测量夜间温度的装置。

column1: The new findings, published in the journal Science, show that phytochromes control genetic switches in response to temperature as well as light to dictate plant development.
column2: 发表在《科学》期刊上的新研究表明，光敏色素既能响应光，也能响应温度，并通过控制基因开关来调节植物发育。
column8: in response to|响应；对……作出反应

column1: At night, these molecules change states, and the pace at which they change is ‘directly proportional to temperature’, say scientists, who compare phytochromes to mercury in a thermometer.
column2: 科学家说，这些分子夜间会改变状态，变化的速度“与温度成正比”。他们把光敏色素比作温度计里的水银。

column1: The warmer it is, the faster the molecular change – stimulating plant growth.
column2: 温度越高，分子变化得越快，从而促进植物生长。

column1: Farmers and gardeners have known for hundreds of years how responsive plants are to temperature: warm winters cause many trees and flowers to bud early, something humans have long used to predict weather and harvest times for the coming year.
column2: 几百年来，农民和园丁都知道植物对温度有多敏感：暖冬会让许多树木和花卉提早萌芽，人们也一直借助这一现象来预测来年的天气和收获时间。

column1: The latest research pinpoints for the first time a molecular mechanism in plants that reacts to temperature – often triggering the buds of spring we long to see at the end of winter.
column2: 最新研究首次明确指出，植物体内有一种能对温度作出反应的分子机制；冬尽时我们盼着看到的那些春芽，往往就是它催发的。

column1: With weather and temperatures set to become ever more unpredictable due to climate change, researchers say the discovery that this light-sensing molecule also functions as the internal thermometer in plant cells could help us breed tougher crops.
column2: 气候变化将使天气和气温越来越难预测。研究人员说，发现这种感光分子还可充当植物细胞内部的温度计，或许有助于我们培育出耐受力更强的作物。
column10: tougher crops|耐受力更强的作物

column1: ‘It is estimated that agricultural yields will need to double by 2050, but climate change is a major threat to achieving this.
column2: “据估计，到2050年，农业产量需要翻一番；但气候变化给实现这一目标带来了重大威胁。

column1: Key crops such as wheat and rice are sensitive to high temperatures.
column2: 小麦和水稻等主要作物对高温很敏感。

column1: Thermal stress reduces crop yields by around 10% for every one degree increase in temperature,’ says lead researcher Dr Philip Wigge from Cambridge’s Sainsbury Laboratory.
column2: 温度每升高一度，热胁迫就会使作物产量降低约10%，”剑桥大学塞恩斯伯里实验室的首席研究人员菲利普·维格博士说。

column1: ‘Discovering the molecules that allow plants to sense temperature has the potential to accelerate the breeding of crops resilient to thermal stress and climate change.’
column2: “发现植物用来感知温度的分子，有望加快培育能耐受热胁迫和气候变化的作物。”
column5: has the potential to|有望；有潜力

column1: In their active state, phytochrome molecules bind themselves to DNA to restrict plant growth.
column2: 处于活性状态时，光敏色素分子会与DNA结合，抑制植物生长。

column1: During the day, sunlight activates the molecules, slowing down growth.
column2: 白天，阳光使这些分子活化，从而减缓植物生长。

column1: If a plant finds itself in shade, phytochromes are quickly inactivated – enabling it to grow faster to find sunlight again.
column2: 如果植物处在阴影里，光敏色素便会迅速失活，使植物能加快生长，重新获得阳光。

column1: This is how plants compete to escape each other’s shade.
column2: 植物就是这样相互竞争，以摆脱彼此的遮阴。

column1: ‘Light-driven changes to phytochrome activity occur very fast, in less than a second,’ says Wigge.
column2: “光引起的光敏色素活性变化非常快，不到一秒就能发生，”维格说。
column7: in less than a second|不到一秒

column1: At night, however, it’s a different story.
column2: 到了夜里，情况却不同。

column1: Instead of a rapid deactivation following sundown, the molecules gradually change from their active to inactive state.
column2: 日落后，这些分子并不会立即失活，而是从活性状态逐渐转变为非活性状态。

column1: This is called ‘dark reversion’.
column2: 这个过程称为“暗逆转”。

column1: ‘Just as mercury rises in a thermometer, the rate at which phytochromes revert to their inactive state during the night is a direct measure of temperature,’ says Wigge.
column2: “就像温度计里的水银会上升一样，光敏色素在夜间恢复到非活性状态的速率，直接反映了温度，”维格说。

column1: ‘The lower the temperature, the slower the rate at which phytochromes revert to inactivity, so the molecules spend more time in their active, growth-suppressing state.
column2: “温度越低，光敏色素恢复到非活性状态的速度就越慢；这样一来，这些分子处于抑制生长的活性状态的时间就更长。

column1: This is why plants are slower to grow in winter.
column2: 因此，植物在冬天生长得比较慢。
column3: This is why|这就是……的原因

column1: Warm temperatures accelerate dark reversion, so that phytochromes rapidly reach an inactive state and detach themselves from the plant’s DNA – allowing genes to be expressed and plant growth to resume.’
column2: 温暖的环境会加快暗逆转，使光敏色素迅速进入非活性状态，并与植物的DNA分离；这样基因就得以表达，植物也能恢复生长。”

column1: Wigge believes phytochrome thermo-sensing evolved at a later stage, and co-opted the biological network already used for light-based growth during the downtime of night.
column2: 维格认为，光敏色素感测温度的功能是在较晚阶段演化出来的。它利用夜间的空当，借用了原本就参与光控生长的生物网络。
column6: at a later stage|在较晚阶段

column1: Some plants mainly use day length as an indicator of the season.
column2: 一些植物主要以白昼的长短作为判断季节的依据。

column1: Other species, such as daffodils, have considerable temperature sensitivity, and can flower months in advance during a warm winter.
column2: 另外一些植物，例如水仙，对温度相当敏感，在暖冬时能够提前数月开花。

column1: In fact, the discovery of the dual role of phytochromes provides the science behind a well-known rhyme long used to predict the coming season: oak before ash we’ll have a splash, ash before oak we’re in for a soak.
column2: 事实上，人们长期用一句民谣预测下一季的天气，而光敏色素双重作用的发现给这句民谣提供了科学解释：“栎树先发叶，雨只落几滴；白蜡先发叶，大雨淋透衣。”

column1: Wigge explains: ‘Oak trees rely much more on temperature, likely using phytochromes as thermometers to dictate development, whereas ash trees rely on measuring day length to determine their seasonal timing.
column2: 维格解释说：“栎树对温度的依赖大得多，很可能是用光敏色素充当温度计来调控发育；而白蜡树是根据白昼长短来掌握季节节律的。

column1: A warmer spring, and consequently a higher likeliness of a hot summer, will result in oak leafing before ash.
column2: 如果春天较暖，夏季炎热的可能性也就较大，而在这种情况下，栎树就会比白蜡树先长叶。

column1: A cold spring will see the opposite.
column2: 寒冷的春天，情形则恰好相反。

column1: As the British know only too well, a colder summer is likely to be a rain-soaked one.’
column2: 英国人再清楚不过，较凉的夏天往往也会雨水淋漓。”
column6: rain-soaked|adj. 被雨淋透的；多雨的

column1: The new findings are the culmination of twelve years of research involving scientists from Germany, Argentina and the US, as well as the Cambridge team.
column2: 这些新发现是十二年研究的成果。参与者除剑桥大学的团队外，还有来自德国、阿根廷和美国的科学家。

column1: The work was done in a model system, using a mustard plant called Arabidopsis, but Wigge says the phytochrome genes necessary for temperature sensing are found in crop plants as well.
column2: 这项研究是在一个模式系统中完成的，使用的是一种名叫拟南芥的十字花科植物。不过，维格说，感知温度所必需的光敏色素基因也存在于农作物中。

column1: ‘Recent advances in plant genetics now mean that scientists are able to rapidly identify the genes controlling these processes in crop plants, and even alter their activity using precise molecular “scalpels”,’ adds Wigge.
column2: 维格补充说：“得益于近年植物遗传学的进步，科学家如今能够很快找出农作物中调控这些过程的基因，甚至可以用精准的分子‘手术刀’改变它们的活性。”

column1: ‘Cambridge is uniquely well-positioned to do this kind of research as we have outstanding collaborators nearby who work on more applied aspects of plant biology, and can help us transfer this new knowledge into the field.’
column2: “剑桥开展这类研究有得天独厚的条件。我们身边有优秀的合作者，他们研究植物生物学中更偏应用的领域，能帮助我们把这些新知识带进田间。”
column3: uniquely well-positioned|处于得天独厚的位置
column10: into the field|到田间实际应用中
